elements.text: 1. Sedition Charges against Shri Sitaram Yechury and Shri D. Raja, Members and Threat to Life over Phone to Shri Sitaram Yechury

runs.text: D. Raja, Members and Threat to Life over Phone to

elements.text: SHRI T.K. RANGARAJAN:  I would like to take up the sedition case against the CPI(M) leader and the Party Joint Secretary, Shri Sitaram Yechury, and hon. Members of this House, Shri D. Raja and Shri K.C. Tyagi. We have fought for the country’s freedom. We have a tradition of political integrity. In this House, hon. Ministers and Members make speeches without any authentic proof. Now, all these speeches have resulted in a threat to Shri Sitaram's life. I would like to know whether the Chairman has received any notice about the arrest of Shri Sitaram Yechury and others.

2. Alleged Molestation of Some Women in Murthal, Haryana on 22.02.2016 by Anti-Social Elements

runs.text: 2. Alleged Molestation of Some Women in

elements.text: KUMARI SELJA: In Haryana, very shameful acts have been committed  lately. There is no law and order in the State. Government is a silent spectator. The incident of Murthal has shaken the conscience of everybody. Taking cognizance of the matter, the High Court has issued a notice to Haryana government and has asked the state to conduct a judicial inquiry into the happening. But, we do not trust Haryana government. We demand a judicial probe into the matter to bring out the facts.

3. Resentment among Land-losers of Malthon Power Station in Dhanbad, Jharkhand

SHRI SANJIV KUMAR: Thousands of acres of land have been acquired for 1050 megawatt power plant at Nirsa in Dhanbad district of Jharkhand. While acquiring the land,a job was promised on the basis of merit to family members of the farmers whose lands were being acquired. But, so far only a few people have been provided jobs. I demand that the farmers whose lands were acquired should be provided jobs on the basis of merit and they should also be given medical facilities.

4. Concern over Plight of Oil-palm Farmers

DR. K.V.P. RAMACHANDRA RAO: The plight of oil-palm farmers in the States of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh is very miserable. The oil farmers across the States of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh are no more in a position to cultivate palm -oil. So, they have already started cutting palm-oil trees and this will affect the production of oil in our country. If trees are cut it will take a minimum of five years which will give a hard time to farmers. Therefore, the Government must come forward to give subsidies.

5. Alleged Opposition of Villagers of Naqueri and Betul in Quepem Taluka of South Goa to the Proposed Defence Exposition

runs.text: of South Goa to the Proposed Defence Exposition

elements.text: SHRI SHANTARAM NAIK: The villagers in and around the villages of Naqueri and Betul in Quepem Taluka of South Goa District are highly agitated over the proposal of Defence Ministry to hold a defence exposition in the locality. The State Government has given permission despite the fact that the land is a land belonging to Goa Industrial Development Corporation. It is strange that the Goa Government, apparently has succumbed to the pressure of the Central Government to allot the land to the defence exposition. In the last six months there have been many agitations against it.
